entries.title: Share debug logs — one click, one paste.
entries.text: Settings now has a 🐞 button that copies a redacted error report to the clipboard: both halves of the error black box (service worker + page), the extension version, the current site, and live quick-buy chip diagnostics including WHY any chip is hidden. Secrets and wallet keys are stripped at record time, before anything is stored — the report is safe by construction. Nothing is transmitted anywhere: you are the transport. Paste it in Discord and a bug report arrives pre-forensic'd instead of starting a twenty-question thread.
